title: Replacing Ed Lewis as Basie's first trumpet
summary: Young says he replaced Ed Lewis, whose age probably ended his time, and that doing so helped put swing into the band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Okay, so how about Al Killian?

I replaced Ed Lewis. I replaced Ed Lewis and the only way I replaced Ed Lewis, I think his age got him out of Count Basie‘s band. And Ed Lewis was a hell of a first trumpet player, but I worked beside him for a long time when we played in Basie‘s band and Ed Lewis was still in there, but I guess, knock on wood [knocks on wood], I guess I must have been lucky to replace Ed Lewis to take his place in that band, because that band that‘s when it got to be, how can I say? It put swing back into, not back into it, into it. And then it was another band called, what‘s that white band, swing suppose to be the world‘s greatest…
